analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($149.75) vs SMA5/20/50 ($161.76/$162.18/$164.42) — Below short- and mid-term moving averages, entering a bearish zone.
· Significant drop vs SMA100/200 ($177.93/$212.45) — Confirms weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (4.0%) + Near 52-week low ($139.11) — Located near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.8→41.9) — Extreme oversold conditions persist, downtrend continues.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8270→-0.3847) — Bearish crossover and strengthening downward momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $151.24) — Approaching the lower band, downward pressure continues.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($147.88) — Key support level near the 52-week low.
· Swing resistance ($173.09) — Resistance zone aligning with short-term moving averages and upper Bollinger Band.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — 5-day low ($139.11) equals 20-day low ($139.11), and 5-day high ($169.69) is lower than 20-day high ($181.49) — Suggests range-bound movement and potential bearish reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.28x 5-day average) — Sharp increase in volume accompanying the decline indicates strong selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Extreme oversold RSI, no trend ADX, and five consecutive down days suggest potential for further decline, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
